schema.title: Git LFS pointer file
schema.description: Git LFS specification v3.8.1, The Pointer: a text file of `{key} {value}` lines; the first key is always version; the required keys are version, oid and size.

version.description: A URL that identifies the pointer file spec; parsers MUST use simple string comparison (e.g. https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1).

oid.description: The unique object id for the file, prefixed by its hashing method `{hash-method}:{hash}`; currently only sha256 is supported, and the hash is lower case hexadecimal.
